_readme: Resolved L2 generator configuration. Source: tools/seeds/generator.json (tool settings, hand-authored) resolved by build_data.mjs against data/items.json + data/rules.json. Goal and threat item lists are DERIVED from item stat keys; the slot rule is rules.slots (deadlock.wiki, UNVERIFIED in game). Read by js/generator.js; never hand-edited.

weights._readme: q = 1 + evidence*E + goals*G + counters*C - timing*T, floored at qMin; an item is worth cost * q; investment adds investment * spend * bonus/topBonus per item type.

evidence._readme: E = liftShare * clamp(tierLift / liftScalePct, -1, 1) * n / (n + shrinkMatches) + buyShareShare * buyShare. tierLift = this item's win rate on the hero minus the purchase-weighted win rate of the other items of the same tier on that hero (late items look better because winning players can afford them; comparing within a tier removes most of that).
evidence._gateReadme: PICK GATE (a lock is the only way past it): an item with fewer than minSample matches on the chosen hero, or one that loses against its own tier while fewer than buyShareFloor of the hero matches buy it, is never picked. FIT CAP: the goal and counter lift of any other item is multiplied by min(1, buyShare / buyShareFloor) and by (1 - negativeLiftDamp * clamp(-tierLift / liftScalePct, 0, 1)) when the item loses against its own tier, so a goal cannot carry an item almost nobody on this hero buys into the build.

counters._readme: An enemy is a threat of a kind when that hero's players put a bigger share of their item souls into it than the average hero: excess = share / average - 1, capped at excessCap. A threat counts only above minExcess.
